correctness.rationale: Independent replay (python3 /workspace/branches/independent_petersen.py) generates all 331 nonempty matchings by recursive disjoint-edge extension, checks the 160 pairs and acyclicity on all 975 Hasse arcs, and obtains one critical vertex, five 2-cells, five 3-cells and zero integral differential. Hurewicz identifies each 3-cell attaching class with its degree vector in the simply connected wedge of 2-spheres, so these attachments are null. The replay builds actual integral cycles lifting the critical cell generators and transports them by signed label permutations before projecting; exact traces are (5,−3,1,2,0,−1,0) and (5,1,1,−1,1,−1,0) in the seven stated classes, without modular lifting. These are the signed point character and the 2-set permutation character less the point character, respectively. After equivariant subdivision, quotient chains are orbit coinvariants with rational coefficients, and averaging identifies homology with invariants; the sign-twisted point module contributes precisely one invariant on A5 and none on S5, and the Specht module contributes none on either. This proves rational quotient homology, not a quotient homotopy type or an integral module classification.
